$comment: Dependency sets whose native images are pre-built into /hexcache (forward/build/prebuild-natives.js).

Only packages with C/C++ or build settings change the image: core, jacdac and some bundled libraries (datalogger via flashlog, audio-recording, bitmap). TypeScript-only extensions (all fwd-* packages, jacdac-* services, ws2812b) don't.
Every new project starts with core, radio and microphone. Forward's released extensions use pxt-jacdac v1.9.41 and v1.9.42, so both are built.
